title: introduce-intake-quality-tiers-and-compact-change-indexer
author: Aisha Gupta
description: Context: onboarding churn and noisy release notes for model uploads make it hard for downstream teams to interpret compatibility and quality impacts. This PR introduces two coordinated features: 1) intake quality tiers (bronze/silver/gold) computed from a small probe suite and metadata heuristics; 2) a compact change indexer that generates a concise changelog fragment and a deterministic index token that surfaces in model manifests. Goals: reduce manual curation for release briefs, make basic quality signals machine-readable for routing and rollout automation, and produce compact changelog snippets for release notes automation. Includes a lightweight signing hook that allows release-generator to attach a provenance token (no HSM integration in this PR).Scope: changes to intake pipeline, onboarding CLI, manifest schema, changelog composer, and a small set of UI annotations for the registry.Why now: teams have requested faster auto-briefs for model patches and easier gates for Dedicated deployments (see ENG-987).This PR contains: checklist: - [x] compute probe-driven quality score and map to tier (bronze/silver/gold) - [x] add tier to manifest and onboarding API - [x] implement compact change indexer that hashes key fields to make short index tokens - [x] wire change index into release-note draft generator - [x] add unit + integration tests for pipeline and CLI - [x] docstring and API surface docs updated - [x] simple signing hook for provenance token (non-production key) Rollout plan: stage rollout behind feature flag 'intake_quality_tiers' for 2 weeks with telemetry; backfill is optional and can be run for recent 30 days of ingests.Compatibility notes: manifest adds optional fields 'quality_tier' and 'change_index' and is backward compatible with existing consumers; onboarding clients older than 2025-12 must use graceful fallback.Hosted automation: release composer will prefer compact change fragments when present; else will fall back to auto-draft heuristics.Contacts: @aisha for infra, @samir for eval, @evelyn for release tooling. Linked work: ENG-987 (auto-briefs), ENG-1024 (dedicated gating).

review_comments: Samir Patel: Left an inline question on scorer edge cases — how do we handle TTR (time-to-response) probes for large-context models? || Aisha: Reply: TTR is normalized by model tokenizer length; added clarifying comment and unit test to cover 0-length edge case.

Evelyn Shaw: Can the compact change indexer collate multiple tiny deltas into a single fragment? || Aisha: Reply: yes, indexer supports coalescing by change-type; added option in composer (--coalesce-small-deltas) and tests.
Jian Li: Suggest adding a telemetry counter to measure fraction of ingests that map to each tier. || Aisha: Reply: Added metrics.ingest_quality.tier_count and dashboard stub.

Evelyn Shaw: Security: the signing hook uses an ephemeral key in this PR; gate HSM integration to a follow-up. || Aisha: Reply: noted in docs and added an 'hsm_integrated' flag to the signer interface.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-02-19 by Evelyn Shaw after CI green and 2 approvals. Release note generation will be toggled under feature-flag 'intake_quality_tiers' and rollout to production controlled via release pipeline.
release_notes: - Introduces intake quality tiers (bronze/silver/gold) computed at model ingest; used for routing and rollout hints. || - Adds compact change indexer to produce deterministic short changelog fragments embedded in manifests. || - Adds small provenance token/signing hook for release automation (non-production key). || Migration: fields are optional and backward compatible; consumers can ignore missing fields.
notes_for_operators: Backfill: run 'cli/onboard.py --backfill-quality --days 30' when ready. Monitor metrics.ingest_quality.tier_count and release.compose.fragment_hits. Feature flag: feature/intake_quality_tiers toggles production behavior.
